reference.author: Horst J. Meuter
reference.camera_metadata_policy: Source-published location is preserved as metadata; exact lens, yaw, pitch and crop are not asserted.

framing_bound.method: Perspective projection from registered camera/target geometry plus a conservative clearly-visible Atomium witness; this constrains an upper FOV bound and does not recover the historical lens.

capture_evidence.scope: specialist-workspace deterministic Godot capture; not a current-main runtime capture

reality_status.resolved_by_this_lot: Reject the stale 50 degree global benchmark as too wide; adopt 31.5 degrees only as a conservative evidence-bounded candidate.
remaining_blockers: Current-main deterministic Atomium runtime capture is still absent.
Exact yaw, pitch, crop and historical lens remain unresolved.
Fountain/basin and paved open-space geometry remain the largest immediate source-to-game foreground mismatch.
Vegetation massing remains incomplete relative to the lawful reference.
Atomium support-leg orientation and sphere/tube foreshortening still require side-by-side runtime validation.
